verdict.rationale: Langfuse is an AI engineering platform with an LLM Playground and experiments, so letting users plug in MCP servers for tool use is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only shows Langfuse publishing its own MCP server for other AI tools to connect to (server role). Nothing shows Langfuse acting as an MCP client that consumes external servers' tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
